# Templates

**Folder purpose:** one template per kind of document, to copy when starting a new one.

## Folder overview

| Read                                     | For                                             |
| ---------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| [`folder-readme.md`](folder-readme.md)   | Starting the README of a folder under `docs/`   |
| [`overview.md`](overview.md)             | Starting the overview of a part of the system   |
| [`glossary-entry.md`](glossary-entry.md) | Adding a term to [the glossary](../glossary.md) |
